analytical_note: Same FSSAI 09.001:2024 numbering appears as 2024 AAS/GFAAS versus ICP-OES in different hosted manuals; the latter published Pb/Cr/Ni LOQ of 6/5/3 mg/kg respectively; official final adoption and the 18 Sep 2026 laboratory amendment original text are not authenticated here. Full manual title, notified version and lab-achieved method/matrix performance are mandatory.

rows.product: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
rows.source_level_finding: 2011 CTR metal schedule: historical Lead entries including 'Foods not specified' and distinct beverage/infant-food entries; source table does not authenticate whether dispensed vending water is packaged drinking water.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Vending-unit licence, fill/dispense procedure, outlet sample point and evidence whether sold in a sealed package.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Obtain legal classification and separate water-specific accredited Pb method; never transfer packaged-water row merely from the word 'drinking'.

rows.source_level_finding: 2011 original Lead schedule separately lists 'Infant Milk substitute and Infant foods'; it cannot be applied to an age-distinct children's formulated supplement without lawful finished-food classification.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Front/back pack showing ages, exact 24–36-month eligibility if relied upon, licence category, formulation and as-consumed basis.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Ask regulatory reviewer to document why the actual product is or is not an infant-food article; current law and matrix analytical scope still unverified.

rows.source_level_finding: 2011 original Copper schedule distinguishes 'Pulp and pulp products of any fruit' from 'Foods not specified'. Source-level difference is verified, but neither category is automatically selected for dried seedless tamarind.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Manufacturer material form: seed removal, dried flesh vs wet pulp, moisture specification, additives and actual sales label.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Require legal view of dried seedless tamarind versus fruit-pulp classification before setting copper standard; actual laboratory Cu matrix LOQ still required.

rows.source_level_finding: 2011 original generic food-Lead category is a historical research candidate only. Infant or animal-dairy milk articles do not automatically cover a coconut-derived plant powder.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Signed BOM identifying coconut/dairy ingredients, fat %, protein sources, spray-drying agents and packaged-powder form.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Fat-rich powder may exceed 40% fat and the published AAS method explicitly excludes milk powder; require actual matrix validation, LOQ and laboratory authority.

rows.source_level_finding: Original 2011 Lead schedule names cocoa powder on a dry-fat-free basis, not raw cocoa beans. It cannot be transferred to a whole bean, roasted bean or nib simply because each derives from cocoa.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Bean supplier traceability, fermentation/roasting stage, whole bean or nib state, measured moisture/fat and representative sampled lot.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Before proposing any Pb route, check operative cocoa-bean-specific law and accredited method for whole-bean digestion.

rows.product: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
rows.source_level_finding: Original cocoa-powder Lead row on dry-fat-free matter and refined-white-sugar rows are separate. Neither transfers automatically to a cocoa-and-sugar finished dry mixture.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Commercial packed-mix ingredient composition: exact cocoa %, sugar %, fat %, and as-sold finished-product specification.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Regulatory decision must evaluate the composite finished-food article, then adopt a case-appropriate Pb method only with blend matrix proof.

rows.product: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
rows.source_level_finding: Original 2011 Lead schedule names cocoa powder, not cocoa mass, chocolate liquor or press cake. Different fat fractions and processing stages preclude blind 5 mg/kg dry-fat-free transfer.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Separate lot specifications and identities for cocoa mass/liquor versus press cake, moisture, measured fat, and raw cocoa source.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Separate high-fat cocoa liquor from lower-fat press cake in legal classification and method validation; AAS 09.001 excludes foods with fat >=40%.

rows.source_level_finding: Original 2011 CTR Chromium entry names 'Refined Sugar'; Misri has separate published product identity and is not necessarily refined white sugar for contaminant purposes.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Misri raw sugar source, crystallization process, refining or non-refining specification, purity, label and supplier original batch identity.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Require legally signed refined-sugar vs Misri article comparison; do not adopt published ICP-OES Cr LOQ 5 mg/kg for a much smaller hypothetical limit.

rows.product: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
rows.source_level_finding: Original 2017 FSSR 3.2.16 monograph specifically establishes Sorbitol (INS 420, CAS 50-70-4) nickel and lead purity criteria; the FoSCoS umbrella explicitly excludes individually standardized polyols. This original monograph cannot be applied to xylitol, erythritol or mixed non-standardized polyols.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Actual supplier INS/CAS per polyol, percentages, blend status and grade with certificate identifying the physical polyol lot.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Do not inherit Sorbitol Ni <=2 mg/kg for grouped non-standardized polyols; published ICP-OES Ni LOQ 3 mg/kg is itself above the sorbitol-only 2 mg/kg comparison.

rows.product: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
rows.source_level_finding: Original 2011 lead metal schedule has milk/infant-food-associated rows, but 2011 wording does not explicitly prove that bovine colostrum or dehydrated colostrum finished products inherit a milk contaminant class.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Species, postpartum collection time, liquid versus powder classification, additives, dairy fat %, reconstitution instruction and original lot.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Obtain independent FSSR colostrum-specific classification and raw vs reconstituted laboratory LOQ; do not presume that fresh liquid milk limits transfer.

rows.source_level_finding: Original October 2024 CTR amended honey-production antibiotic misuse and named honey MRPL entries; it did not in the cited provision expressly name royal-jelly products, so honey thresholds cannot simply be inherited.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Pure royal-jelly finished SKU, apiary/bee medication treatment records, specific antibiotic molecules, residue-definition and authentic sample CoA.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Obtain commodity-specific published rule for royal jelly, or authoritative written opinion; require antibiotic-specific method validated for royal-jelly matrix, not ICP metals.

rows.source_level_finding: Original 2011 historical 'Foods not specified' lead row is not direct evidence that 102.1 Ayurveda Aahara Category A coconut/dairy recipe inherits that fallback; a Category18 sweets direction cannot be transplanted to Category102.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Actual Category102.1 Central licence, original listed-recipe conformance document, cooked-water/fat profile, ingredient and claim declaration.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Seek separate original Gazette applicability determination to the specific Ayurveda recipe; do not assert that an unrelated sweets category supplies its lead ceiling.

rows.source_level_finding: Original 2011 generic Lead fallback cannot be bound to 102.1 Ayurveda Aahara botanical-milk composite by resemblance to milk; the 2021 Category18 direction is category-restricted.
rows.specific_external_material_needed: Licensed Ksheerapaka Category102.1 recipe, herbs/milk amounts, disease-risk claims, heat process, dry solids and actual lot details.
rows.independent_legal_or_laboratory_next_dec: Independently determine legal contaminant article for the cooked botanical-milk marketed food; require exact matrix digestion performance.
